name: hlp-ebm-academy
description: An interactive academy for learning evidence-based medicine, literature searching, critical appraisal, journal peer review, and evidence synthesis. Education and research methodology only.

interface.longDescription: A guided educational workspace for healthcare professionals, researchers and students to learn evidence-based medicine, build verifiable PubMed strategies, practice critical appraisal and journal peer review, and learn systematic reviews, meta-analyses and other evidence syntheses. Uses stepwise demonstrations, simulated exercises, structured feedback and source verification; does not provide patient-specific advice.
defaultPrompt: Teach me how to critically appraise and peer-review an RCT, step by step.
Help me build a PICO and reproducible PubMed search strategy.
Guide me through a systematic review protocol, one step at a time.

publication.release_notes: Initial public-release preparation for HỌC EBM. Adds submission-ready listing metadata and a primary app icon while preserving the five-skill EBM architecture, native interaction, source verification, reproducible-search workflows and Update by Bing safeguards.
